hints.manual: Set manually; kept when syncing and applying rules
hints.rule: Assigned by a rule; source rule not recorded

categories.title: Categories
categories.loadFailed: Your categories could not be loaded
categories.empty: Add a category to organize your transactions.

rules.title: Rules
rules.loadFailed: Your rules could not be loaded
rules.applied: Rules applied. Manual assignments have been preserved.
rules.empty: For example: “MARKET” in the payee or description → Groceries. Manual corrections always take precedence.
rules.orderFailed: The new order could not be saved, so the previous order was restored: {message}
rules.move: Move rule {rule}, position {position, number} of {total, number}

reorder.pickedUp: Picked up {name} at position {position, number} of {total, number}.
reorder.over: {name} is at position {position, number} of {total, number}.
reorder.dropped: {name} dropped at position {position, number} of {total, number}.
reorder.cancelled: Moving {name} was cancelled; it returned to position {position, number}.
reorder.instructions: To move a rule, press Space or Enter on its handle, use the arrow keys to choose its position, then press Space or Enter again to drop it or Escape to cancel. Rules match from the top; existing transactions change only when you apply the rules.

impact.enterPattern: Enter a pattern to see the matching transactions.
impact.disabled: This rule is disabled, so it matches no transactions until you enable it in the list.
impact.matches: Matches {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}

ruleForm.name: Rule name
ruleForm.noCategories: A rule needs a category, and none exist yet.
ruleForm.patternHint: Matches payee and description, ignoring case. The first matching rule wins.
ruleForm.transferHint: Links matching bookings to this account.

matches.summaryUnchanged: Matches {total, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}, none would change
matches.summary: Matches {total, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}, {changing, number} would change
matches.hidden: Showing the newest {shown, number}; {hidden, plural, one {# older transaction is} other {# older transactions are}} not listed.

adoption.singleSame: It already has this rule's category. Otherwise it stays manual.
adoption.same: They already have this rule's category. Otherwise they stay manual.
adoption.singleDiffering: It has a different category, which the rule would replace. Otherwise it stays manual.
adoption.differing: {differing, plural, one {# of them has} other {# of them have}} a different category, which the rule would replace. Otherwise they stay manual.
adoption.label: Also let this rule decide {count, plural, one {# manually categorized transaction} other {# manually categorized transactions}}

fromAssignment.enterPattern: Enter a pattern to see what the rule would categorize.
fromAssignment.none: Would not categorize any other transactions yet.
fromAssignment.matches: Would categorize {matched, plural, one {# other transaction} other {# other transactions}}; {uncategorized, plural, one {# of them is} other {# of them are}} uncategorized.
fromAssignment.description: Categorize transactions like “{example}” automatically. The first matching rule wins. This transaction follows the rule when the rule decides its category; other manual assignments only follow it when you choose so below.
fromAssignment.patternHint: Contained in the payee or description, without case sensitivity.
fromAssignment.orderHint: The rule is added at the end of your rules; reorder it in the rule list. Other matches follow the rule when rules are applied.

ruleEffects.matching: New and re-applied transactions no longer match this rule; the next matching rule decides instead.
ruleEffects.categorized: Transactions it already categorized keep their category until you apply the rules.

deletion.usageFailed: What uses this category could not be loaded
deletion.reassignHint: Transactions and rules use the chosen category instead; reports count them there.
deletion.uncategorizeHint: Transactions become uncategorized and reports show them as Uncategorized. Its rules are deleted, since a rule needs a category.
deletion.categoryNote: Manual assignments stay manual, so applying rules later does not change them. This cannot be undone.
deletion.usage: Used by {transactions, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} and {rules, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}}.
deletion.usageWithManual: Used by {transactions, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} ({manual, plural, one {# manual assignment} other {# manual assignments}}) and {rules, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}}.
